Let me check one reference per class, starting with Die_Back.
Strong match — same brown, shriveled, desiccated leaf on a dark stem, same white background, same overall presentation. Now check one from each other class.
Anthracnose: yellowish-green leaf with brown lesions/rotting areas, not a fully desiccated shriveled leaf. Doesn't match the test image.
Powdery Mildew: green leaf with white powdery spots/patches. Completely different from the test image.

Sooty Mould: green leaf with black/dark sooty coating. Nothing like the test image.

All other classes are ruled out. Die_Back is clearly the match. Let me use my remaining 4 views to confirm with more Die_Back references.

All 8 views used. The evidence is unambiguous:

- **Die_Back** references (all 3 viewed): brown, completely desiccated/shriveled leaves on dark stem tips, white background — identical presentation to the test image.
- **Anthracnose**: green/yellow leaves with discrete dark lesions — no match.
- **Powdery_Mildew**: green leaves with white powdery coating — no match.
- **Sooty_Mould**: green leaves with black sooty deposits — no match.
